events.description: ATB extended the Loan Facility to Gemini by commitment letter; Gemini granted the GSA, securities pledge and leasehold mortgage; Gemec gave a guarantee and GSA
events.quote: pursuant to a Commitment Letter dated May 25, 2017
as amended by an amending agreement dated December 19, 2017

events.description: Since December 2017 Gemini has sought additional liquidity without success
events.quote: Since December 2017, Gemini has been trying to find an additional source of liquidity.

events.description: Alberta and BC PPR searches were run on Gemini
Gemini had a $3,000,000 margin shortfall (reported April 8, 2018)
events.quote: showing a $3,000,000 margin shortfall as of March 31, 2018

events.description: Gemini gave ATB a cash flow forecast projecting margin shortfalls up to $6,409,000
events.quote: On April 6, 2018, Gemini provided an updated cash flow forecast to ATB

events.description: Gemini provided an updated margin report
events.quote: On April 8, 2018, Gemini provided an updated margin report
As of April 12, 2018, Gemini is indebted to the Lender in the sum of $12,853,334.36

events.description: ATB demanded repayment from Gemini and Gemec and served notices of intention to enforce security
events.quote: On or about April 14, 2018, ATB demanded repayment of the Indebtedness from Gemini

events.description: Gemini and Gemec failed to repay the indebtedness
events.quote: Gemini has failed, refused or neglected to repay all of the Indebtedness.

events.description: FTI Consulting Canada Inc. consented to act as receiver
events.quote: FTI Consulting Canada Inc. is qualified and prepared to act as receiver

events.description: Holland swore the affidavit in Calgary
events.quote: I make this Affidavit in support of ATB's application for a receivership order
